messages.plaintextBody:
Hello all,

We're running a lunch-and-learn on extended disclosure under PD 57AD on Friday 30 January at 12:30 in the Bishopsgate boardroom. Sandwiches provided. Please reply to me if you'd like to attend so I can order numbers.

Donna
